usedBy: Not used on its own. It is the content block of every Transaction List item: Read Only, Action, Selectable, Expandable and the child items. Pass these props in the item’s `content` prop.
overview: Shows what happened and who it relates to: a small title line, an emphasized description and an optional caption with the date or reference. Text wraps up to two lines and then truncates with an ellipsis.

default.title: Default
default.text: Title (small line), description (emphasized) and caption. Keep one fact per line.

strikethrough.title: Strikethrough
strikethrough.text: `status="strikethrough"` with `strikethroughDescription` shows the original text struck through before the new one, such as a changed due date.

inverted.title: Inverted
inverted.text: On by default: the description is the emphasized line. Set `inverted={false}` to emphasize the title instead.

status.title: Status
status.text: `status` changes the color and weight of the emphasized line: `positive`, `warning`, `highlight`, `highlight-lead` and `inactive`. Disabled items force `inactive`.

size.title: Size
size.text: `size="sm"` for dense lists and child items. In the items, `content.size` is independent from `amount.size`.

rules: Write the title in the product vocabulary, such as "Payment to supplier" or "Sales received".
Use the description for the counterpart: supplier, retailer, card or bank.
Keep one fact per line; don’t join facts with separators.
Use the caption for the date, the order number or the due date.

api.title: What happened, such as "Payment to supplier". With `inverted` it is the small line. Required.
api.description: Who or what the transaction relates to. One fact only.
api.caption: Date, order number or due date.
api.strikethroughDescription: Original text shown struck through before the emphasized text. Only with `status="strikethrough"`.
api.inverted: Emphasizes the description instead of the title.
api.status: Color and weight of the emphasized text. Ignored when the item is disabled.
api.size: Type scale of the block, independent from the amount.
